credits.title: Bad Apples
credits.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

credits.title: F**k Ups
credits.overview: After dedicating her entire teen existence to greatness, Miracle June Jones is forced to face the horrifying reality that even the most disciplined can f**k up

credits.title: A Bear Remembers
credits.overview: Local boy, Peter, is trying to find the source of the metallic sound that haunts the village. When he shares his footage with an old woman it sparks memories of a bear that roamed the hills during her childhood.

credits.title: The Guvnors
credits.overview: A violent thriller set amongst the clans and firms of South-East London, bringing two generations together in brutal conflict.
